record.title: LFP | A123 18650M1A / Jahn2024 | modeled PD-ECM OCPn

temperature.description: Characterization protocol at 25 degC per Methods; parameterized model table, not a temperature sensor trace.

x.definition: Author model SOC/DOL coordinate, not verified absolute electrode lithium fraction.
x.domain_basis: Retained native coordinate endpoints; no extrapolation.

cell_link.evidence: Paper Methods names A123 18650M1A and electrode harvesting after intact-cell tests. The deposited author script loads these OCPn MATs and the A123_01 full-cell files. Exact serialized specimen/file mapping is not supplied.

processing.changes: Native pot_dol and positive electrode-potential pot nodes copied unchanged. Source model negates graphite pot during full-cell assembly; this catalog retains its physical positive potential versus Li/Li+. Author spline/PCHIP/extrapolation is not reproduced by the catalog's bounded linear interpolation.

limitations: Paper Methods names A123 18650M1A and electrode harvesting after intact-cell tests. The deposited author script loads these OCPn MATs and the A123_01 full-cell files. Exact serialized specimen/file mapping is not supplied.
OCPn is approximated and parameterized from electrode data; it cannot be measured directly (paper Parameterization). These arrays are not raw GITT/half-cell measurements.
Model SOC/DOL is not established as absolute stoichiometry. LFP potential rises with this coordinate. Geometry, balancing and coordinate orientation need explicit review before DFN/SPM/SPMe reuse.
No intrinsic diffusivity or Butler-Volmer kinetics inferred from ECM quantities.
